layouts.name: VA City Hill Climb
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The operator identifies the climb on Nevada Highway 341, independently mapped as Occidental Grade with ref SR 341. The selected continuous source-node route follows the catalogue timing extent and measures 7247.3 m. The operator advertises a longer 5.2 mile event; this draft does not assert the current event endpoints. Neither a return road nor an artificial closure is included. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 7247.3 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
